title: International macro and finance
summary: This ECB web page is a navigation/index listing that outlines research priority areas for international macroeconomics, including global spillover effects, financial globalisation, exchange rate dynamics, and the international role of the euro. It contains no specific policy decisions, data releases, forward guidance, or actionable content—it is a structural listing page describing research themes rather than an actual policy document or research output.
